//: Used in: app/(onboarding)/consent/index.tsx (consent namespace). Marketing opt-in (email + push), shown to EVERY locale. The body MUST name both channels (email + push notifications): Apple 4.5.4 and GDPR informed consent require the channels in the visible consent language, not just this comment. Keep DISTINCT from the notifications permission step users hit right before this: frame this as optional tips/offers so it doesn't read as a repeat.
heading: Tips & offers
body: We'll send you marketing tips, product updates, and offers by email and push notifications to help you get more from Tagly. Turn it off anytime.
